item.title: How to Buy Qatar Airways Privilege Club Avios
item.description: Qatar Airways Privilege Club is offering up to a 50% bonus when you buy Avios for a limited time.
item.content:encoded: Qatar Airways Privilege Club is one of seven loyalty programs that uses Avios as its points currency. By buying Avios cheaply and redeeming them for high-value rewards, you could save substantial amounts of money on Business Class flights.

item.title: Airfare of the Week: Delta Air Lines Premium Economy Brisbane – Los Angeles from $2,987
item.description: Delta has round-trip Premium Economy fares from Brisbane to Los Angeles from $2,991, flying nonstop on its Airbus A350.
item.content:encoded: Our newest Airfare of the Week belongs to Delta Air Lines, which has round-trip Premium Economy fares from Brisbane (BNE) to Los Angeles (LAX) from $2,897.
